checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: Independent generation starts from h33=-sqrt(35)(x+iy)^3/4 and uses the orbital lowering operator, then h_minusm=(-1)^m conjugate(h_m). All seven polynomials, degree 3, harmonicity, lz eigenvalues and addition identity match. This preserves the negative-m/conjugation signs.
All nine independent polynomial entries give 4pi G=21r^2(2r^2 I+rr^T). G is Hermitian positive. Omitting conjugation would not establish the required Gram. Spectral slack is21r^2 C(r)_dagger C(r).

The local spectrum is42,42,63 timesr^4/(4pi), with63 reached by a parallel local vector and trace 147. Coefficient63 is sharp only for this gradient map; many-body moment/projection inequalities are conservative and no nuclear transition saturation is claimed.

checks.topic: contracted ordering and fixed g coefficients
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: Common smooth-domain Hessian contraction permits l dot F=F dot l; l remains a derivative. For L3 the orbital coefficient is g_l/2. Fixed bounded particle g coefficients are assumed; uncontrolled coordinate/velocity-dependent operators or currents are outside this argument.

The local PSD matrix bounds the direct sum over all seven magnetic components by 63R^4/(4pi) times the vector norm. Particle and spin/orbital triangle inequalities yield A3=sum|g_s|sqrt(S_k)+(1/2)sum|g_l|sqrt(L_k), and BM3max=63mu(M)^2R^4A3^2/(4pi).

Purification or Hilbert-Schmidt operator vectors extend the local spectral inequality to mixed rho. Component norms are Tr(rho s_k^2) and Tr(rho l_k^2) on the same controlled domain. The initial density must belong to the same good-spin multiplet and preserve the common-rho comparison.

checks.topic: fixed-Mi B and no second spin divisor
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: Final-multiplet projection can only reduce the squared component norm. The complete response is scalar on a fixed initial irreducible multiplet, so a normalized density gives the same B. Independent rank3 Ji=Jf=2 unit-BM-RME response has A_dagger A=I5/5. Inputs are B bounds and must not be divided by 5 again.

Hard common support, normalized states/density, finite particle sector, fixed charges/g, common smooth or validated form domain and independent orbital/spin ceilings are required. Typical/rms radius, high unbounded orbital moments or unestimated finite-q/current/tail corrections cannot supply these inputs.

For fixed 2+->2+, M1/E2/M3/E4 exhaust allowed real-photon modes. Complete radiation integration adds their nonnegative widths. Positive q and the same-pair B2floor give Gamma_ret>=C2q^5B2min>0; upper numerators yieldr_rate<=u3+u4. Relative phases remain relevant for directional interference.

required_reuse_boundaries: Keep all seven complex standard-Y harmonics and conjugated gradient Gram. Coefficient63 is sharp for the local map, not necessarily a physical transition or the many-body bound.

Use fixed bounded particle g coefficients, common smooth or justified form domains and the adopted nonrel/long-wave polynomial currents across allfour modes. Uncontrolled coordinate/velocity-dependent g operators and extra currents need separate audits.
Support, charges, spin/orbital moments and current validity are external hypotheses. Typical/rms radius or normalization alone does not establish them; large moments may leave the nonrel regime.
The mixed-state argument requires the same initial good-spin multiplet and final orthonormal multiplet. Physical B already includes the initial-spin normalization; do not divide by5 again.

An independent positive E2 floor must concern this exact pair in the full adopted model. Other-branch reference strengths or target-truncation-dependent fits do not automatically supply it. Priors must be jointly feasible.

Use one common Gaussian charge/moment/length system. mu(M) has charge*length; bare numerical mu_N^2 b^2/e^2 b^2 is not dimensionless. No physical conversion constants or energies/radii were inserted here.

Retained photon width is at least the same-pair E2 width at positive q. The budget controls allM3+E4 rates for this fixed spin/parity link, not parent-level total branching, IC or other decay channels.

The old sqrt(epsilon) andkappa5 connections compare a full model with its unchanged retained-amplitude projection using the same rho/current/energy/radial mode. Arbitrary refits or recomputed time/lifetime modes need additional comparisons.

Use the common full radiation-plus-final-spin emitted-space distance, not an unaudited smaller photon-only distance with the samekappa. Generic response-support changes or inverse weighting need separate bounds.
q->0+ with fixed priors is only a controlled limit; q0 has no normalized emitted-photon chart. A missing/shrinking floor or growing moment ceiling can invalidate a small-q argument.

The resulting errors are expected forward-model absolute probability/density bounds. They do not provide parameter confidence intervals, inverse stability, finite-count significance, relative node accuracy or conditional polarization bounds without denominator floors.

Dimensionless teaching numbers are not independently realized physical priors. No real truncation validity, microscopic realization, source-authored theorem, experiment, Human review or paper admission is claimed.
